## Independent reviewer reproduction

```powershell
$env:NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED = '1'
$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE = '1'
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/actor-memory.test.ts
corepack pnpm run ci
py -3 -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p "test_*.py" -v
git diff --check
git status --short --branch
```

Pass means the focused suite reports 6/6, full CI reports 97/97 and exits `0`, governance reports 7/7, diff check has no errors, and only the documented Prompt 12 plus Prompt 11 acceptance-reconciliation paths are changed. Passing does not mark PB2-12 ACCEPTED.

## Diff summary

The change replaces generic actor registries with canonical strict ownership, adds atomic once-only memory creation and explicit repeat-fatigue behavior, exposes evidence-gated red-line knowledge, and supplies an opt-in conditional adaptation resolver at the registered source step. It adds no real actor intent, production coefficient, unified AES stance, hidden-state leak, or second mutable source of truth.
